description: RAG Triad benchmark cases modeled after a technical lab report (see BENCHMARK_DOCUMENT in runner.py). Direct extraction questions have their answers on a single page; synthesis questions require combining multiple pages; the out-of-scope case verifies refusal and groundedness behavior.

cases.question: How many soil samples were used in the calibration experiment?
What is the mean absolute error reported for the calibrated sensor?
Summarize the calibration methodology, including the reference points used and how long readings were logged.
What do the results say about measurement accuracy, and which limitation remains uncharacterized?
What was the total budget of the research grant that funded this project?
